usage: AddPairEndAlleleDepth.py [-h] [--bam_fn BAM_FN] [--ctg_name CTG_NAME]
                                [--clair3_vcf_input CLAIR3_VCF_INPUT]
                                [--vcf_output VCF_OUTPUT] [--threads THREADS]
                                [--filter_tag FILTER_TAG]
                                [--samtools SAMTOOLS] [--min_mq MIN_MQ]
                                [--min_bq MIN_BQ]

Add pair-end allele depth to Clair3 VCF file output

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --bam_fn BAM_FN       Sorted BAM file input, required
  --ctg_name CTG_NAME   The name of sequence to be processed
  --clair3_vcf_input CLAIR3_VCF_INPUT
                        Clair3 VCF input
  --vcf_output VCF_OUTPUT
                        VCF output path
  --threads THREADS     Max #threads to be used
  --filter_tag FILTER_TAG
                        Filter tag for the input VCF
  --samtools SAMTOOLS   Path to the 'samtools', samtools version >= 1.10 is
                        required. default: samtools
  --min_mq MIN_MQ       DEBUG: If set, reads with mapping quality with
                        <$min_mq are filtered, default: 5
  --min_bq MIN_BQ       DEBUG: If set, bases with base quality with <$min_bq
                        are filtered, default: 0
